translations.web: “ ‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am Yahweh.’ ”
translations.bsb: You must keep all My statutes and all My ordinances and follow them. I am the LORD.”
translations.kjv: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.
